en.html:
At last my awareness connected with reality.

The office. The small company where I worked.

Outside the window it was still bright. Proper working hours, and I had been sleeping through them. Deeply, by the look of it.

This scene I had last seen when I fell asleep—naturally, when else? Yet it felt as though years had passed. An entirely unreasonable feeling.

Kageaki"But, sir—"
ｅｔｃ／部長"Work yourself flat when there is no work, then collapse when there is work: where does that leave me?"
Kageaki"............"
ｅｔｃ／同僚女"Exactly. For us salaried people, the body is the capital. Maintaining it is also company work."
Kageaki"...That is true."
ｅｔｃ／同僚女"So my afternoon nap is also company work. Haan, now you understand. All this time I was working with my eyes closed. The shocking truth has finally come out."
ｅｔｃ／部長"...See? With an employee like this, the company is still running. You can go without worrying."
Kageaki"Yes..."

en.html:
I put on the armor.

What—power.

Every wild beast on earth would be left behind by this transcendent violence. Such power was here.

And clean power! Exhilarating!

Power that hated evil.

Those conceited creatures who used their mighty strength to torment the weak—this was power to crush them with a violence greater still.

Justice, exactly!

Its very embodiment!

en.html:
There was evil, directly before me.

The bandit warrior trying to kill my foster mother!

At the sight of me, he seemed to panic. Fool! So he thought power was his alone!

Only he could hurt people with violence, just as he pleased—was that what he had believed?

Now he would receive the answer to that arrogance.

Before the iron hammer of justice, evil's violence must shatter!
